flags.title: three different home-court values are pinned in this repository at once
flags.measured: this build pins 0.9 from the league-wide measured home-win rate 0.5204 (102-94 in 196 home games, Wilson 95% 0.4507 to 0.5893); the round capture pins 4.12 from 22 finals (rate 0.5909); every entry in data/app/ledger/ledger.jsonl records the constant 1.62. Spread: 3.22 points
flags.why_it_matters: the pin is applied to every line, so this build's home margins are -3.22 points different from the same model run at the previously pinned value; the brief requires the pin to be the measured home-win rate, and the league-wide measurement (n = 196) beats a 23-final sample (n = 22), but two published surfaces now disagree and neither is wrong on its own basis
flags.action: owner decision: adopt the standings-based pin everywhere (this session's recommendation) or keep the short-sample pin for continuity with the sealed ledger entries; do not silently re-pin, because the sealed hashes contain the old value

The 11/19 page's strip is consistent with the reports (Garland LAC, Jerome MEM — and MEM's report does carry a Jerome row), so the disagreement is specific to the strip, not to the league's roster data

flags.action: treat the strip as a display artefact of a different feed and ask its owner; recorded here so no later session reads a club assignment off it — no row on this site does

flags.surface: integrity of this session's own work
flags.title: a manual test run wrote two stray stamp directories into another session's path
flags.measured: data/app/refresh/T1 and T2 appeared under the canonical refresh directory after this session ran the five test modules by hand; they were removed in the same session and no published artefact was touched. The test itself writes to a temp directory (tests/test_refresh_official.py passes --stamp inside a tempdir), so the residue came from how the modules were invoked, not from the test's design

flags.action: nothing to fix in the code; recorded so no later session mistakes T1/T2 for captures
